crossRefs.note: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again; but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we…
the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of…
A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

translations.web: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
translations.bsb: He will rescue you from six calamities; no harm will touch you in seven.
translations.kjv: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch
translations.asv: He will deliver thee in six troubles; Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
